payload.leagueSummary: NET is a three-headed fight right now: MattF, Dan94, and KeithK75 are clustered at the top, with BigTime lurking because the irons are doing most of the heavy lifting. The gross side mostly agrees, which means this window isn’t some weird net-only illusion — the best ball-strikers are generally the ones cashing in. Underneath that, the league splits hard between the guys living on approach shots and the guys setting their money on fire off the tee and then trying to tiptoe out of the bunker swamp.
leagueBullets: BigTime’s profile is basically one giant approach-shot flex: absurd iron play, enough short-game support, and very little else trying to ruin it.
Dan94 and KeithK75 are the cleanest all-around threats, but Dan is the tee-force monster while Keith is the purest approach machine in the room.

The bottom half is a disaster movie with different costumes: IUDoc92 can hit irons, but the rest is leaking; Leroy4522 and derekldavis are getting eaten alive before the scorecard can even get sentimental.
